headword: {気象予報士|きしょうよほうし}

definitions.explanation: A person who holds Japan's national weather forecaster qualification, created in 1994. Companies that sell forecasts must have them made by licensed forecasters. Also the familiar figure who presents the weather on TV.

examples.japanese: {気象予報士|きしょうよほうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got my weather forecaster qualification.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気象予報士|きしょうよほうし}だ。
examples.english: She is a weather forecaster on TV.

examples.japanese: {気象予報士|きしょうよほうし}⟦によると→〜によると：03104_niyoruto⟧、⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}まる→強まる：02295_tsuyomaru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: According to the weather forecaster, the rain will get heavier from tomorrow afternoon.
